authority: Existing all-project local development grant. DE-W105 remains current and unqualified; this preparation neither completes that dependency nor authorizes an external campaign.
slice: Explicit expected observation set and fail-closed comparator routing, followed by identity, artifact and managed-runner work
expected_set: The corpus manifest declares expected_observations as unique {name,participant,kind} tuples before collection. Native records use participant native and explicit kind native; external receipt keys name their participants. A nonempty exact set must include native and reference observations. Diagnostic-only records remain in the set even when projection is null.
regressions: No external participants, empty observations, duplicate observations, unknown cases/participants/kinds and empty or duplicated expected tuples cannot pass adapter controls.
Every record binds the corpus hash, byte length, logical unit and block count; mismatches are invalid independently of any matching table projection.
A complete declared set can pass the set check while still lacking executable/source/raw-artifact qualification. Set completeness alone must never yield complete_success.
Retain valid GPT disagreement and both candidates; diagnostic-only observations do not invent projections.
The CLI must require complete_success, rather than the historical adapter_controls_passed flag alone.
remaining_gates: Complete participant code/build/profile and raw-artifact identity validation
Upgrade collectors and frozen campaign manifest production
Managed output, process ownership and success/failure/interruption cleanup under a qualified worker
DE-W105 dependency, work review and actual external/native qualification
forbidden: No obsolete WSL recipe, physical media, new installation, guest policy change, larger budgets, capture qualification, owner acceptance or main integration.

cli_predeclared_scope.external_identity: Require PARTICIPANT=PATH arguments;reject duplicate participant names before dictionary construction.
cli_predeclared_scope.routing: Require DISKED_WORK_ROOT outside the repository. Manifest,receipts and report must remain beneath it without linked paths. This is a routing check,not an OS quota proof.
cli_predeclared_scope.bounds: At most8 external receipts;8MiB per JSON input and16MiB aggregate accepted JSON;64MiB streamed report maximum. Reject duplicate fields,non-finite numbers and nonordinary/multiple-link files. Small-budget writer controls exercise refusal without producing large output.
cli_predeclared_scope.retention: Create the report exclusively;never overwrite prior evidence. A complete set with unverified artifacts writes its result but returns failure.

cli_expectation_timing: The CLI fields were added after its first code draft and before its first evaluation. The initial expected-set contract preceded the initial comparator implementation.
